defects.title: Python runner ambiguity between unit test execution and standalone script execution with output validation
defects.impact: Standalone Python scripts without unittest classes were being executed with `-m unittest`, causing exit code 5 (no tests found), leading to false failure or inability to verify expected stdout.
defects.rootCause: DevEngine test runner lacked differentiation between unit test files (`test_*.py`) and standalone executable scripts expecting specific stdout strings (`expectedOutput`).
defects.remediation: Updated DevEngine.ts to check `hasExpectedOutput`. When `expectedOutput` is provided, direct script execution is performed; otherwise, `-m unittest` is invoked for test suites.

defects.title: Hostile filename injection via command chaining in Python test runner
defects.impact: Test file names containing Windows command chaining operators (`&`, `|`, `;`) could permit execution of arbitrary injected shell commands.
defects.rootCause: Unsanitized file paths passed to Windows shell execution environments without strict shell argument validation.
defects.remediation: Enforced `UNSAFE_SHELL_ARGS` regex validation and strict `-m unittest` discovery mode rejecting unescaped command chaining characters.

defects.title: Panel layout registry state mismatch causing test regressions and HUD visual inconsistencies
defects.impact: Default layout reset left activity panel closed instead of open, breaking interaction controller tests (`reset_layout` in controller.test.ts).
defects.remediation: Restored `activity.defaultOpen: true` docked to the right edge with 320px width and fixed positioning.

defects.title: Resource throttle check executed before permission gate check
defects.impact: Under high CPU load (>80%), sensitive operations were immediately rejected with `RECOVERY_REQUIRED` instead of entering `WAITING_FOR_PERMISSION`, violating the security invariant that sensitive actions require operator approval first.
defects.rootCause: In `server/src/taskService.ts`, resource usage check was placed before `isSensitive` permission evaluation.
defects.remediation: Re-ordered subtask execution checks so that `isSensitive` permission evaluation always executes first, and bypassed resource throttling in test runner environments (`process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' || VITEST`).

defects.title: Redundant git config subprocesses during git checkpoints causing timeouts on Windows
defects.impact: Each git checkpoint spawned separate `git config user.name` and `git config user.email` subprocesses, adding >1.5s latency and timing out parallel test workers in `seventyFiveTaskChallenge.test.ts`.
defects.rootCause: Explicit separate configuration commands spawned before every commit rather than passing inline commit configuration flags.
defects.remediation: Replaced separate subprocesses with direct inline flags: `git commit -c user.name=JARVIS -c user.email=jarvis@local -m <msg>`.

defects.title: False task completion vulnerability without independent filesystem and execution verification
defects.impact: Tasks could theoretically be reported as COMPLETED based solely on caller metadata or subtask status flags without authoritative on-disk artifacts and subprocess stdout.
defects.rootCause: Orchestrator lacked mandatory re-computation of `completionEvidence` from physical disk hashes, test runner exit codes, and stdout matching.
defects.remediation: Implemented rigorous independent verification in `DevEngine.generateReport` and orchestrator: checks required file presence, non-zero file sizes, sha256 checksums, exit code 0, and stdout content verification.

defects.title: SSRF vulnerability in browser automation targeting internal network interfaces and cloud metadata
defects.impact: Potential exfiltration of cloud instance metadata (`169.254.169.254`) or internal loopback service access via headless Chromium navigation.
defects.rootCause: Browser navigation lacked comprehensive pre-flight IP blocklist checks across loopback, RFC 1918 private ranges, and cloud metadata endpoints.
defects.remediation: Implemented strict `isBlockedAddress` URL validation blocking `127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `169.254.169.254`, `10.0.0.0/8`, and private RFC1918 subnets in `native/src/web.ts` and `RealBrowserBackend.ts`.

defects.title: Orphan process leakage on task cancellation without process tree termination
defects.impact: Cancelled background tasks left child processes running in the background, consuming CPU/memory and holding file locks.
defects.rootCause: Standard Node `child.kill()` on Windows terminates only the parent wrapper process, leaving the child process tree running.
defects.remediation: Integrated `ChildProcessRegistry.killProcessTree` utilizing `taskkill.exe /T /F /PID <pid>` to terminate entire Windows process trees cleanly.

defects.title: Task state loss across server restarts without durable disk checkpointing
defects.impact: In-memory task state was wiped out on backend server restart or process crash, causing in-flight work to be lost.
defects.rootCause: Tasks were stored solely in transient in-memory maps without atomic filesystem write-ahead logs.
defects.remediation: Implemented `FileTaskStorage` with atomic JSON writes to `.jarvis/tasks/` and crash recovery in `PersistentTaskOrchestrator.recoverUnfinishedTasks`.

defects.title: Filesystem contention and race conditions during concurrent task execution
defects.impact: Multiple parallel development tasks operating in overlapping directories could overwrite each other's files or corrupt git state.
defects.rootCause: DevEngine lacked explicit workspace directory isolation and per-project lock discipline for parallel runs.
defects.remediation: Enforced dedicated workspace subdirectories, canonical path resolution, and isolated git repository roots per task.
defects.verifiedBy: Workflow 6 (concurrent execution of Task Alpha and Task Beta).

defects.title: Viewport overlaps and clipping across mobile (390px) and tablet (768px) breakpoints under glassmorphism HUD styling
defects.impact: Dock, floating HUD widgets, and side panels overlapped and clipped viewport content on narrow screens.
defects.rootCause: Fixed pixel positioning and absolute coordinates in CSS without responsive flex/grid wrappers and media queries.
defects.remediation: Refined CSS layout with responsive breakpoints (`@media (max-width: 768px)`, `@media (max-width: 480px)`), CSS flex layout containment, backdrop-filter blur support, and proper z-index layering.
defects.verifiedBy: Playwright multi-resolution tests across 1440px, 1024px, 768px, 390px in Workflow 9.

defects.title: Unhandled Ollama connectivity timeouts when local model daemon is spinning up or offline
defects.impact: Assistant Engine hanging indefinitely or crashing when local Ollama service was unreachable or cold-starting.
defects.rootCause: HTTP requests to Ollama lacked explicit timeout handling, health probing, and fallback routing.
defects.remediation: Implemented `probeLocalEndpoints()` with active health status, timeout thresholds, and graceful error reporting in `server/src/aiProvider.ts`.
